1 # Release notes: payments-api build 5.36.1-f33d
2 
3 Previous build: 5.35.4. Defaults below override repository config files.
4 
5 - metrics: new histogram for cache hit latency
6 - security: TLS session tickets rotated hourly
7 - docs: runbook links updated
8 - scheduler: cron jitter added to cleanup job
9 - feature flags: `ff-legacy-export` removed (was 0%)
10 - locale: currency formatting fixes
11 - batching: max batch size default 200 (unchanged)

13 - clients: default `clients.risk-score.timeout_ms` lowered from 2500 to 800 (fail fast)
14 - cache: default `cache.ttl_s` unchanged (120)
15 - tracing: sampling rate default 1% (unchanged)
16 - db: default connection pool `db.pool.max_size` lowered from 60 to 14 to fit the shared-db connection quota
17 - retry: idempotent GETs retried once on connect errors
18 - deps: http client library upgraded to a patch release
19 - logging: structured request ids added to access logs
20 - config: `log.level` default remains info
21 - build: container base image refreshed
22 - deps: json serializer upgraded
23 - api: `/v1/status` returns build id
